port.description: TCP port postgres listens on, for both client and replication connections

database.description: Name of the database created on the initial primary at bootstrap

replicationPassword.description: Password for the internal 'replicator' role standbys use to stream from the primary. Required: pg_hba.conf trusts only the WireGuard overlay CIDR, but a shared secret is still needed since every node is on that overlay

superuserPassword.description: Password for the postgres superuser over TCP (local Unix-socket admin access, used by the failover controller, is trust and needs no password)

maxWalSenders.description: max_wal_senders — must exceed the replica count plus headroom for pg_basebackup

maxReplicationSlots.description: max_replication_slots — the controller creates one physical slot per standby
